lines: PRE-CONTACT 3D TUCK: PARTIAL — starts at the push-off, the knee is in place at contact; hip / knee / ankle still lag their targets there
FOLDED KNEE PLACEMENT: PASS — under the fold hip at contact (8 cm more medial than SP2A) and through the slide; a 3 cm midline crossing ≈ 150 ms after landing
FOLDED ANKLE/BOOT TUCK: PARTIAL — studs away, no hanging heel; the authored plantarflexion is pushed back to neutral on the turf
TOE/STUD CLEARANCE: PASS — fold toe / sole share 0; no stud engagement by either boot during the slide
LATERAL LEG/THIGH/HIP SLIDING SURFACE: PASS — hip/pelvis ≈ 50%, shin + knee + thigh 33–42% of the braking, torso 0%
ACTIVE FOLLOW-THROUGH: PARTIAL — organised and muscularly held through the slide, state-triggered recovery; arms balance without posting, the ending is a seated recovery, not a get-up
PASSIVE RAGDOLL-LIKE ENDING REMOVED: YES — never face-down, head never on the turf, seated upright at 6 s at all three speeds
JOINT LIMITS: PARTIAL — fold-hip external rotation 1.1–1.6° past the stop while seated (SP2A 6–10°); brief ankle / knee / thoracic excursions at landing
PHYSICAL SLIDE PRESERVED: YES — 4.45 / 5.49 / 6.93 m vs SP2A 4.26 / 5.48 / 6.94 m at F37.5; contacts are the only horizontal force; deterministic
VISUALLY BETTER THAN SP2A: YES (my assessment — for your visual review)
READY FOR FINAL FRICTION CALIBRATION: YES, after you approve the SP2C organisation
note: SP2C = SP2A + diagnosed changes: compact 3D tuck from the push-off, trunk counter-lean (the roll-over diagnosis), held regional authority, follow-through to 6 s and a state-triggered seated recovery. F37.5 is a temporary development friction, not canonical.
